name: Fashion & Apparel
functionTitle: Find sizes and reserve for try-on

datasets.title: Business details
datasets.why: What the plug-in says about the business and where customers can reach it.

columns.label: Business name
columns.help: As customers know it.

columns.label: Summary
columns.example: NoDa Threads serves customers in and around Charlotte, NC.
columns.help: One or two sentences, in the business's own words.

columns.label: Public email
columns.help: The address customers may write to.

columns.label: Public phone
columns.help: With country code.

columns.label: Website
columns.help: Full URL.

columns.label: What you are
columns.help: A few words shown after your name in ChatGPT, e.g. "Harbor Street Studio – Yoga in Charlotte". Without it, the plug-in's industry is shown.

columns.label: Logo URL
columns.help: Your own logo as an https image, square if you have one. Shown next to your plug-in in the BizPlug portal, and as its icon in ChatGPT.

columns.label: Wide logo URL
columns.help: Optional: your logo with your name, wider than it is tall, as an https PNG, JPEG or WebP image. From plug-in version 0.25.0 it heads your card in ChatGPT and Claude; without it the card shows the logo above.

columns.label: Address
columns.help: Street address, if customers visit.

columns.label: Opening hours
columns.help: As shown to customers.

columns.label: Currency
columns.help: ISO code for the prices in the other files.

columns.label: Delivery fee
columns.help: Number only, in your currency. Added to every delivery order and its checkout; pickup orders never carry it. Leave empty if delivery is free or you price it yourself.

columns.label: Requests go to
columns.help: The team inbox that should receive requests from ChatGPT (not shown to customers).

collect: Copy the name, summary, phone, email, website and address exactly as they appear on the business's website or Google Business Profile.
Write the summary in the business's own words (one or two sentences). Do not add claims the business does not make.
Ask the owner which inbox should receive requests from ChatGPT and put it in notify_email.

datasets.title: Catalog (garments)
datasets.why: What customers can order, with prices. The plug-in only offers garments in this file.

columns.label: Item id
columns.help: Short, unique, lowercase with hyphens. Never reuse an id for a different item.

columns.label: Price
columns.help: Number only, no currency sign.

columns.label: Available
columns.help: true or false; false hides it.

columns.label: Photo URL
columns.help: The business's own photo (https). Leave empty rather than using someone else's image.

collect: With a Shopify shop or a Square account, import the list on the plug-in's page in the portal (Or import it from your shop) instead of making the file.
Export the product or menu list from the point-of-sale or online shop (Square, Shopify, Toast, Clover and similar all export CSV), or copy it from the website menu.
Map the export's columns to the template: one row per item, price as a plain number.
Only include photos the business owns.

datasets.title: Services list
datasets.why: A short list of what the business offers, used in answers.

columns.label: Service
columns.help: One per row.

collect: List the services from the website's services or about page, one per row, short names only.

datasets.title: Questions and answers
datasets.why: The plug-in answers customer questions only from these, so it never guesses.

columns.label: Question
columns.example: How long do you hold items for try-on?
columns.help: How a customer would ask it.

columns.label: Answer
columns.example: We hold reserved items for 48 hours.
columns.help: The business's answer, in full sentences.

collect: Take the FAQ page of the website first, then policies (cancellation, delivery, payment, parking, accessibility).
Keep each answer factual and current. Leave out anything the owner has not confirmed.

datasets.title: Social media
datasets.why: Where to follow you, and your latest posts with their pictures, shown under Social media in the plug-in. Feeds (YouTube, podcast, blog, Substack, Medium, Bluesky, Mastodon) are read automatically; for LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and TikTok you pin the posts you want shown. From plug-in version 0.35.0 a YouTube video plays inside the card.

columns.label: Kind
columns.help: "follow" for a profile to follow, "feed" for a public feed BizPlug reads (YouTube channel, podcast or blog RSS, Substack, Medium, Bluesky or Mastodon profile), "post" for one post you pin.

columns.label: Network
columns.help: instagram, linkedin, facebook, x, tiktok, youtube, threads, bluesky, mastodon, podcast, blog, substack, medium, pinterest or whatsapp. Left empty, it is read from the address.

columns.label: Address
columns.help: The profile, the feed or the post, as an https address.

columns.label: Picture
columns.help: For a pinned post: its picture, an https PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

columns.label: Text
columns.help: For a pinned post: its caption, or the first lines of it.

columns.label: Date
columns.help: For a pinned post: YYYY-MM-DD.

collect: Take the profiles from the links on the business's own website (header or footer).
Add a feed row for a YouTube channel, a podcast or blog RSS, a Substack, Medium, Bluesky or Mastodon profile; its latest posts appear by themselves.
Pin a few recent posts from LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook or TikTok with their own picture and text: only posts the business published.
A pinned post may also be one of the business's own YouTube videos (a watch, youtu.be or Shorts address): it plays inside the card, and needs no picture.

never: Passwords, API keys or other secrets.
Card numbers, bank details or government ID numbers.
Customers' personal data (names, phone numbers, addresses, health or financial details).
